CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`text` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`memories`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_search_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `memories` BEGIN DELETE FROM `memory_search` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_search_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `memories` BEGIN DELETE FROM `memory_search` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_search_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `memories` BEGIN INSERT INTO `memory_search`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_memory_search_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `memories` BEGIN INSERT INTO `memory_search`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END
